biotools.summary: iDog is a multi-omics resource for domestic dogs and wild canids, integrating genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic data. It offers a 15-fold increase in genomic samples and incorporates data for breed-specific SNPs, disease trait-associated variants, and genotype-to-phenotype associations.
